blind_target.authors: Arutyunova, K. R., Bakhchina, A. V., Krylov, A. K., & Alexandrov Yu, I.
blind_target.title: The effects of alcohol on heart rate and evaluation of actions in moral dilemma.
blind_target.evidence_quote: Subsequent laboratory experiments (Arutyunova et al., 2017; Francis et al., 2019) aimed to address this concern, and these studies did not find any significant effects of alcohol on moral judgments. However, the consumed doses of alcohol were relatively small in these experiments.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Despite these improvements, we failed to obtain any significant effect of alcohol on moral judgments.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The paper retests the prior experimental null effect with a higher dose and larger sample; its null result agrees.
